## Rationale

Showing a human title and type with the id secondary matches how Needs you and task rows already prefer readable text, so a reference reads as a thing rather than a database key.

## Counter-argument

Showing only the raw id keeps rows compact and unambiguous. That was rejected because the user's complaint was not knowing what a reference means.

payload.alternatives: Show raw id as the only label
payload.choice: Prefer human title and type as the visible label; show id as secondary or title attribute
